newsitem.title: USA: Mirage, New Jersey reach pact on roadway.
newsitem.headline: Mirage, New Jersey reach pact on roadway.

text.p: Mirage Resorts Inc and the state of New Jersey have reached an agreement to share in the cost of building a new roadway in Atlantic City, clearing the way for casino development in the marina district there.

The deal, which was signed late on Friday after several months of talks, outlines the construction of a new road and tunnel providing better access to the Atlantic City Expressway, the marina and a new convention center.
Mirage had been asking state officials for a commitment to build the road before it proceeded with its casino development in the marina.
Along with Circus Circus Enterprises Inc and Boyd Gaming Corp, Mirage plans to develop Las Vegas-style mega-resorts in the marina district.
Many industry experts believe themed resorts like those built by Mirage and Circus Circus are needed to make Atlantic City a primary destination for gamblers around the world.

However, some current casino operators in Atlantic City, such as real estate mogul Donald J. Trump, opposed the deal, believing it unfairly favored Mirage and the others wanting to develop the marina district.
